evidence.notes: Grouped fields and aggregate aliases project and order AggregateResult rows.
GROUP BY CUBE returns local grouped and subtotal rows.
GROUPING() projects flags for grouped rows.
GROUP BY ROLLUP returns local total rows.
GROUPING() returns 1 on local rollup total rows.
COUNT, COUNT_DISTINCT, SUM, MIN, and MAX over numeric and grouped fields return local aggregate rows.
SOQL FOR UPDATE parses and returns the selected local row.
GROUP BY with HAVING, ROLLUP, CUBE, aliases, and GROUPING executes against local aggregate rows.

source.content: @isTest private class QueryRuntimeSOQLSOSLAggregateProjectionTest { @isTest static void aggregateProjectionAndOptionsRun() { Account acme = new Account(Name = 'Acme', Rating = 'Hot', AnnualRevenue = 100, LastSeen__c = Datetime.newInstanceGmt(2026, 2, 15, 10, 0, 0)); Account beta = new Account(Name = 'Beta', Rating = 'Warm', AnnualRevenue = 250, LastSeen__c = Datetime.newInstanceGmt(2026, 3, 1, 8, 0, 0)); Account gamma = new Account(Name = 'Gamma', Rating = 'Hot', AnnualRevenue = 300, LastSeen__c = Datetime.newInstanceGmt(2026, 2, 16, 9, 0, 0)); insert new List<Account>{acme, beta, gamma}; insert new Contact(LastName = 'Smith', AccountId = acme.Id); List<Object> totals = [SELECT COUNT(Name) namedCount, COUNT_DISTINCT(Rating), SUM(AnnualRevenue) totalRevenue, MIN(AnnualRevenue), MAX(AnnualRevenue) FROM Account]; System.assertEquals(1, totals.size()); Object total = totals[0]; System.assertEquals(3, total.expr0); System.assertEquals(2, total.expr1); System.assertEquals(650.0, total.expr2); System.assertEquals(100.0, total.expr3); System.assertEquals(300.0, total.expr4); System.assertEquals(3, total.namedCount); System.assertEquals(650.0, total.totalRevenue); List<Object> grouped = [SELECT Rating ratingKey, COUNT(Id) accountCount, SUM(AnnualRevenue) totalRevenue FROM Account GROUP BY Rating HAVING accountCount > 1 ORDER BY totalRevenue DESC]; System.assertEquals(1, grouped.size()); System.assertEquals('Hot', grouped[0].ratingKey); System.assertEquals(2, grouped[0].accountCount); List<Object> hiddenHaving = [SELECT Rating FROM Account GROUP BY Rating HAVING SUM(AnnualRevenue) > 300]; System.assertEquals(1, hiddenHaving.size()); System.assertEquals('Hot', hiddenHaving[0].Rating); List<Object> rollupRows = [SELECT Rating, COUNT(Id) accountCount, GROUPING(Rating) ratingGrouped FROM Account GROUP BY ROLLUP(Rating) ORDER BY ratingGrouped]; System.assertEquals(3, rollupRows.size()); Object totalRow = rollupRows[2]; System.assertEquals(null, totalRow.Rating); System.assertEquals(3, totalRow.accountCount); System.assertEquals(1, totalRow.ratingGrouped); List<Object> cubeRows = [SELECT Rating, Name, COUNT(Id) accountCount, GROUPING(Rating) ratingGrouped, GROUPING(Name) nameGrouped FROM Account GROUP BY CUBE(Rating, Name) HAVING accountCount >= 2]; System.assertEquals(2, cubeRows.size()); List<Contact> typeRows = [SELECT Id, TYPEOF Account WHEN Account THEN Name END FROM Contact WHERE LastName = 'Smith']; System.assertEquals(1, typeRows.size()); System.assertEquals('Acme', typeRows[0].Account.Name); List<Account> locked = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Id = :acme.Id FOR UPDATE]; System.assertEquals(1, locked.size()); System.assertEquals('Acme', locked[0].Name); } }
